name: National Dex
description: Registers the full 1025-species national dex with PokeAPI entries and modern typing. As of 0.29.0 the read API also answers abilityById for all 313 main-series abilities -- what each one actually does, in PokeAPI's own words, plus the generation it arrived in and any behaviour change between generations. Nothing here executes: neither engine has an ability system, so this is display data and a handoff for an engine that does. 0.30.0 adds a `behaviour` block to every ability record: its trigger, scope and effects in a closed vocabulary an engine can switch on, curated from PokeAPI's own prose rather than pattern-matched out of it, with an `expressible` flag saying whether the structure captures the ability or whether the text still has to be read.
